Spacecraft name CAPE-2 (CAPE2, OSCAR 75, LO-75)
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status Reentry 2014-10-23. Was semi-operational? Batteries dead and only works in sunlight.
Launched 2013-11-20
NORAD ID 39382
Deployer P-POD (Poly-Picosatellite Orbital Deployer)
Launcher Minotaur I
Organization University of Louisiana at Lafayette

Entity type Academic / Education
Nation US
Launch brokerer Tyvak, ?
Oneliner

Demonstrate CubeSat platform technologies plus voice repeater payload.
Description

To develop a cutting-edge Cubesat communication platform. Secondary Missions: Local Educational Outreach, Deployable Solar Panels, using UHF Radio and VHF Radio. Payloads: Voice Repeater, Text to Speech, Tweeting, Digipeater, File Storage and Transfers, DTMF Query
Failure cause Batteries dead and only works in sunlight.
